programs.title: Bubble's Hotel
programs.desc: Bubble causes Kroomi and Nabi to switch bodies when she accidentally makes a wish upon a star. / Adamant that Bubble's Hotel doesn't make mistakes, Bubble sets out to determine the cause of her guest room mix-up.

programs.title: Beyblade Burst Quadstrike
programs.desc: It's the final stage of the Champion's Challenge and the pressure is on when Pax gives Pri some strict instructions on how to use Pandora. His tactics might help her win but they don't really give Pri the freedom to Blade her own way.

programs.title: Beyblade X
programs.desc: Finally, a new Bey for Team Persona, made by Multi Nanairo, is now complete! At Komaba Sushi, which has been given a party setting, Multi, who has been in high spirits since that morning, is joined by Ekusu Kurosu and the others.

programs.title: LEGO City Adventures
programs.desc: Duke gets a high tech, smart car. He and the temperamental car chase Ice Cream Truck Bandits. // The oblivious Ms. Blumfeld turns into a superhero, stopping crimes around the city, as Duke struggles with his orders to arrest her.

programs.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures
programs.desc: Barbie and friends create a plan to stop smugglers to save a baby whale. As a reward, Barbie gets a ticket to Costa Rica, where she joins her family to see the whales arrive!

programs.title: Theatre Dome
programs.desc: Welcome to the TheatreDome where two teams are battling for eternal acting glory! Jelly takes over on our players excursion to outer space! Can they find any wiggle-room to reach their destination?
